authority: Descriptive rolling two-year weekly reserve projections on core TRC, retaining time variation and declared inference limitations.
estimator: OLS of the weekly H.4.1 reserve change on weekly core TRC (zero route) with the calendar controls, in every window of window_weeks consecutive calendar weeks ending at an observed week
interval: Conventional Newey-West: Bartlett weights 1 - lag/(L+1) over calendar distance with L = hac_width, scale n/(n-k); nominal pointwise 95% normal interval. Coverage not separately calibrated; the period calibration (weekly_reserve_history_v1) found 0.93-0.95 coverage for the restricted bootstrap after 2008.
scope: Descriptive sample dependence of a weekly core-TRC association; overlapping windows are not independent; not the quarterly preferred-TRC coefficient; no landing, retention or causal interpretation.
